q: 妈妈给我买了一件红色___毛衣。
zh: 妈妈给我买了一件红色的毛衣。
py: mā ma gěi wǒ mǎi le yī jiàn hóng sè de máo yī
en: Mum bought me a red sweater.
why: 红色 describes the noun 毛衣, so the link is 的. 得 follows a verb or adjective that is being judged, and 地 comes before a verb; neither can sit in front of a noun.

q: 这是爸爸___车，不是我的。
zh: 这是爸爸的车，不是我的。
py: zhè shì bà ba de chē bù shì wǒ de
en: This is Dad's car, not mine.
why: A owner joined to the thing owned takes 的, as the later 我的 also shows. 得 and 地 never mark possession.

q: 商店里有很多便宜___东西。
zh: 商店里有很多便宜的东西。
py: shāng diàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō pián yi de dōng xi
en: There are lots of cheap things in the shop.
why: 便宜 describes the noun 东西 right after the gap, so 的. 地 would need a verb next, and 得 would need a verb before it.

q: 她喜欢那个很有名___牌子。
zh: 她喜欢那个很有名的牌子。
py: tā xǐ huan nà ge hěn yǒu míng de pái zi
en: She likes that very famous brand.
why: 很有名 describes the noun 牌子, so 的. 地 would only fit if a verb followed, and 得 only after a verb or adjective that is being judged.

q: 这件衣服是姐姐___，我不能穿。
zh: 这件衣服是姐姐的，我不能穿。
py: zhè jiàn yī fu shì jiě jie de wǒ bù néng chuān
en: This piece of clothing is my sister's; I can't wear it.
why: 姐姐的 stands for 姐姐的衣服. The noun is left out because it is obvious, but the particle is still 的; 得 and 地 do not show ownership.

q: 厨房里放着一个很旧___冰箱。
zh: 厨房里放着一个很旧的冰箱。
py: chú fáng lǐ fàng zhe yī gè hěn jiù de bīng xiāng
en: There is a very old fridge in the kitchen.
why: 很旧 describes the noun 冰箱. A word that describes a noun takes 的, even after 很; 地 and 得 do not attach to a noun-describing adjective.

q: 我想给奶奶买一件又轻又暖和___外套。
zh: 我想给奶奶买一件又轻又暖和的外套。
py: wǒ xiǎng gěi nǎi nai mǎi yī jiàn yòu qīng yòu nuǎn huo de wài tào
en: I want to buy Grandma a coat that is both light and warm.
why: 又轻又暖和 is a long description of the noun 外套, so 的 closes it. Length does not change the particle: before a noun it is always 的.

q: 这家店的老板正在介绍一款最新___手机。
zh: 这家店的老板正在介绍一款最新的手机。
py: zhè jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn zhèng zài jiè shào yī kuǎn zuì xīn de shǒu jī
en: The owner of this shop is introducing the newest phone.
why: The gap is followed by the noun 手机 and 最新 describes it, so 的. 得 and 地 both need a verb on one side that is not what 最新 attaches to.

q: 这是妈妈做___菜。
zh: 这是妈妈做的菜。
py: zhè shì mā ma zuò de cài
en: This is the dish Mum made.
why: 妈妈做 is a clause describing the noun 菜, so it is joined with 的 even though a verb stands right before the gap. 得 would need a judgement word like 很好 after it.

q: 我喜欢姐姐送我___花。
zh: 我喜欢姐姐送我的花。
py: wǒ xǐ huan jiě jie sòng wǒ de huā
en: I like the flowers my sister gave me.
why: 姐姐送我 describes the noun 花, so 的. The next word is a noun, which rules out 得 and 地 despite the verb 送 before the gap.

q: 我昨天买___苹果很甜。
zh: 我昨天买的苹果很甜。
py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de píng guǒ hěn tián
en: The apples I bought yesterday are sweet.
why: 我昨天买 modifies 苹果, so 的. 买得 would be followed by a degree word, but here the next word is a noun.

q: 穿蓝裙子___那个女孩是我妹妹。
zh: 穿蓝裙子的那个女孩是我妹妹。
py: chuān lán qún zi de nà ge nǚ hái shì wǒ mèi mei
en: The girl in the blue skirt is my younger sister.
why: 穿蓝裙子 describes 那个女孩, so the clause is joined to the noun by 的. A verb phrase before the gap does not make it 得.

q: 你想买___东西，这家店里都有。
zh: 你想买的东西，这家店里都有。
py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi de dōng xi zhè jiā diàn lǐ dōu yǒu
en: You can find everything you want to buy in this shop.
why: 你想买 modifies the noun 东西, so 的. The tempting 得 needs a judgement or result after it, not a noun.

q: 弟弟打碎___杯子是奶奶最喜欢的。
zh: 弟弟打碎的杯子是奶奶最喜欢的。
py: dì di dǎ suì de bēi zi shì nǎi nai zuì xǐ huan de
en: The cup my younger brother broke was Grandma's favourite.
why: 弟弟打碎 describes the noun 杯子, so 的. 打碎得 would be followed by an adjective such as 很快, not a noun.

q: 住在我们楼上___老人每天早上都去公园。
zh: 住在我们楼上的老人每天早上都去公园。
py: zhù zài wǒ men lóu shàng de lǎo rén měi tiān zǎo shang dōu qù gōng yuán
en: The old man who lives above us goes to the park every morning.
why: 住在我们楼上 describes 老人. The noun after the gap decides: 的. The place word 上 before the gap is not a verb that calls for 得.

q: 他昨天在网上买___那双鞋已经寄到家了。
zh: 他昨天在网上买的那双鞋已经寄到家了。
py: tā zuó tiān zài wǎng shàng mǎi de nà shuāng xié yǐ jīng jì dào jiā le
en: The pair of shoes he bought online yesterday has already been delivered to his home.
why: 他昨天在网上买 is a whole clause describing 那双鞋, so 的. The time and place words do not change that; only the noun that follows decides.

q: 我们刚搬进去___房子离地铁站很近。
zh: 我们刚搬进去的房子离地铁站很近。
py: wǒ men gāng bān jìn qù de fáng zi lí dì tiě zhàn hěn jìn
en: The house we have just moved into is close to the subway station.
why: 搬进去 ends in a direction word, which tempts 得, but 我们刚搬进去 modifies the noun 房子, so it takes 的.

q: 奶奶今天起___很早。
zh: 奶奶今天起得很早。
py: nǎi nai jīn tiān qǐ de hěn zǎo
en: Grandma got up very early today.
why: 很早 judges how she got up, and it follows the verb 起, so 得. 的 would need a noun next, and 地 would need a verb next.

q: 弟弟跑___太慢了，比赛输了。
zh: 弟弟跑得太慢了，比赛输了。
py: dì di pǎo de tài màn le bǐ sài shū le
en: My younger brother ran too slowly and lost the race.
why: 太慢了 judges the running, so it goes after the verb with 得. 地 would put 慢 before the verb as a manner word, and 的 needs a noun.

q: 他走___太快了，我跟不上。
zh: 他走得太快了，我跟不上。
py: tā zǒu de tài kuài le wǒ gēn bù shàng
en: He walks too fast; I can't keep up.
why: 太快了 judges how he walks, so 得 follows the verb 走. 地 would be wrong after a verb, and 的 needs a noun next.

q: 昨天晚上孩子们睡___不太好。
zh: 昨天晚上孩子们睡得不太好。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang hái zi men shuì de bù tài hǎo
en: The children didn't sleep very well last night.
why: The negative goes on the judgement: 睡得不太好. The particle after 睡 is 得, not 的 (no noun follows) or 地 (no verb follows).

q: 妹妹哭___很伤心，妈妈一直哄她。
zh: 妹妹哭得很伤心，妈妈一直哄她。
py: mèi mei kū de hěn shāng xīn mā ma yī zhí hǒng tā
en: My younger sister cried very sadly, and Mum kept comforting her.
why: 很伤心 judges how she cried, so it follows 哭 with 得. 地 would need the feeling word to come before the verb.

q: 今天他们到___特别早，商店还没开门。
zh: 今天他们到得特别早，商店还没开门。
py: jīn tiān tā men dào de tè bié zǎo shāng diàn hái méi kāi mén
en: They arrived especially early today; the shop wasn't open yet.
why: 特别早 says how early they arrived, a judgement placed after the verb 到, so 得. 的 and 地 do not link a verb to a degree word.

q: 爷爷这几天咳嗽___很厉害，我们都很担心。
zh: 爷爷这几天咳嗽得很厉害，我们都很担心。
py: yé ye zhè jǐ tiān ké sou de hěn lì hai wǒ men dōu hěn dān xīn
en: Grandpa has been coughing badly these days, and we are all worried.
why: 很厉害 describes how badly he coughs, so it follows the verb with 得. 地 would need a verb after it, and 的 a noun.

q: 孩子们今天玩___特别开心，晚上都不想回家。
zh: 孩子们今天玩得特别开心，晚上都不想回家。
py: hái zi men jīn tiān wán de tè bié kāi xīn wǎn shang dōu bù xiǎng huí jiā
en: The children had so much fun today that they don't want to go home in the evening.
why: 特别开心 judges how they played, so 得 follows 玩. 地 would put the feeling in front of the verb as a manner word.

q: 这家超市的牛奶卖___特别快，下午就没有了。
zh: 这家超市的牛奶卖得特别快，下午就没有了。
py: zhè jiā chāo shì de niú nǎi mài de tè bié kuài xià wǔ jiù méi yǒu le
en: The milk in this supermarket sells really fast; by the afternoon it is gone.
why: 特别快 judges how the milk sells, so it goes after the verb with 得. 的 would need a noun next, 地 a verb.

q: 我今天累___不想做饭。
zh: 我今天累得不想做饭。
py: wǒ jīn tiān lèi de bù xiǎng zuò fàn
en: I'm so tired today that I don't want to cook.
why: 不想做饭 is the result of being tired, so adjective + 得 + result. 累 is a state, not a manner of cooking, so 地 cannot work.

q: 外面热___人都不想出门。
zh: 外面热得人都不想出门。
py: wài miàn rè de rén dōu bù xiǎng chū mén
en: It's so hot outside that nobody wants to go out.
why: 热 is a state and what follows is its result, so 得. 地 needs a manner adjective in front of a verb, which 热 is not here.

q: 孩子饿___一直哭。
zh: 孩子饿得一直哭。
py: hái zi è de yī zhí kū
en: The child is so hungry that he keeps crying.
why: 一直哭 is the consequence of being hungry, so 饿得. Hunger is a state and cannot be the manner of crying, which rules out 地.

q: 妈妈最近忙___没有时间看电视。
zh: 妈妈最近忙得没有时间看电视。
py: mā ma zuì jìn máng de méi yǒu shí jiān kàn diàn shì
en: Mum has been so busy lately that she has no time to watch TV.
why: 没有时间看电视 is the result of being busy, so 忙得. 忙 is a state, not a way of watching TV, so 地 fails.

q: 屋子里冷___我们都穿上了外套。
zh: 屋子里冷得我们都穿上了外套。
py: wū zi lǐ lěng de wǒ men dōu chuān shàng le wài tào
en: It was so cold in the room that we all put on coats.
why: The clause with its own subject 我们 is the result of the cold, so 冷得. 冷 describes the room, not how anyone put on a coat.

q: 最近东西贵___我都不敢多买。
zh: 最近东西贵得我都不敢多买。
py: zuì jìn dōng xi guì de wǒ dōu bù gǎn duō mǎi
en: Things are so expensive lately that I don't dare buy more.
why: 我都不敢多买 is the result of prices being high, so 贵得. 地 would make 贵 the manner of buying, which is not the meaning.

q: 看到价格以后，我吓___半天说不出话来。
zh: 看到价格以后，我吓得半天说不出话来。
py: kàn dào jià gé yǐ hòu wǒ xià de bàn tiān shuō bù chū huà lái
en: After seeing the price I was so shocked that I couldn't speak for a long while.
why: 说不出话来 is the result of being shocked, so 吓得. 吓 is not a manner of speaking, which excludes 地.

q: 小孩看见新玩具，高兴___睡不着觉。
zh: 小孩看见新玩具，高兴得睡不着觉。
py: xiǎo hái kàn jiàn xīn wán jù gāo xìng de shuì bù zháo jiào
en: The child was so happy about the new toy that he couldn't sleep.
why: 睡不着觉 is a result, and sleeping cannot be done 'happily' when it is impossible, so only 高兴得 fits; 地 would describe the manner of sleeping.

q: 爷爷下棋下___很好。
zh: 爷爷下棋下得很好。
py: yé ye xià qí xià de hěn hǎo
en: Grandpa plays chess very well.
why: 下棋 already has its object, so the verb is repeated and 得 follows the second 下. 得 can never come straight after the object 棋.

q: 爸爸开车开___很慢。
zh: 爸爸开车开得很慢。
py: bà ba kāi chē kāi de hěn màn
en: Dad drives slowly.
why: The verb 开 is repeated after its object 车, and 得 attaches to that second verb before the judgement 很慢. 地 would put 慢 in front of the verb.

q: 哥哥打球打___很好。
zh: 哥哥打球打得很好。
py: gē ge dǎ qiú dǎ de hěn hǎo
en: My older brother plays ball games very well.
why: With the object 球, the pattern is 打球打得很好: verb again, then 得. 地 would not fit, because 很好 is a judgement placed after the verb.

q: 弟弟玩游戏玩___忘了吃饭。
zh: 弟弟玩游戏玩得忘了吃饭。
py: dì di wán yóu xì wán de wàng le chī fàn
en: My younger brother played games so much that he forgot to eat.
why: 玩游戏玩 repeats the verb, then 得 links to the result 忘了吃饭. 玩 is not a manner of forgetting, so 地 is out.

q: 奶奶买东西买___很仔细。
zh: 奶奶买东西买得很仔细。
py: nǎi nai mǎi dōng xi mǎi de hěn zǐ xì
en: Grandma is very careful when she shops.
why: 买东西 has an object, so the verb 买 repeats and 得 attaches to it. 仔细 here is a judgement of how she shops, placed after 得.

q: 妹妹跳舞跳___很好看。
zh: 妹妹跳舞跳得很好看。
py: mèi mei tiào wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo kàn
en: My younger sister dances beautifully.
why: 跳舞 is verb + object, so 跳 is repeated and 得 attaches to the second 跳, followed by the judgement 很好看. 的 would need a noun next and 地 a verb.

q: 哥哥游泳游___比我快多了，他每个周末都去游泳。
zh: 哥哥游泳游得比我快多了，他每个周末都去游泳。
py: gē ge yóu yǒng yóu de bǐ wǒ kuài duō le tā měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù yóu yǒng
en: My older brother swims much faster than I do; he goes swimming every weekend.
why: 游泳 contains its own object, so 游 is repeated and 得 follows it, with the comparison 比我快多了 as the judgement. 的 would need a noun next.

q: 老师说的话我听___懂。
zh: 老师说的话我听得懂。
py: lǎo shī shuō de huà wǒ tīng de dǒng
en: I can understand what the teacher says.
why: Verb + 得 + result word means 'can'. With the meaning 'can understand', 听得懂 is right; 听不懂 would say the opposite and 听的懂 is not a form.

q: 菜不多，我们吃___完。
zh: 菜不多，我们吃得完。
py: cài bù duō wǒ men chī de wán
en: There isn't much food; we can finish it.
why: The cue says 'can finish', so 吃得完. 不 would turn it into 'cannot finish', which contradicts 菜不多. 地 is not used between a verb and 完.

q: 这件衣服太小了，我穿___下。
zh: 这件衣服太小了，我穿不下。
py: zhè jiàn yī fu tài xiǎo le wǒ chuān bù xià
en: This piece of clothing is too small; I can't fit into it.
why: The cue says 'can't', so 不 replaces 得 in the frame 穿不下. 得 would say it fits, which contradicts 太小了.

q: 这条街上有很多店，你想要的东西都买___到。
zh: 这条街上有很多店，你想要的东西都买得到。
py: zhè tiáo jiē shàng yǒu hěn duō diàn nǐ xiǎng yào de dōng xi dōu mǎi de dào
en: There are lots of shops on this street; you can buy everything you want.
why: 买得到 means 'can get', which matches the plenty of shops. 买不到 would mean 'cannot get' and contradict the context.

q: 他的字太小了，我看___清楚。
zh: 他的字太小了，我看不清楚。
py: tā de zì tài xiǎo le wǒ kàn bù qīng chu
en: His writing is too small; I can't read it clearly.
why: The cue says 'can't', and 太小了 explains why, so the frame is 看不清楚 with 不 in place of 得. 得 would claim that I can see it.

q: 这么多衣服，我一个人洗___完。
zh: 这么多衣服，我一个人洗不完。
py: zhè me duō yī fu wǒ yī gè rén xǐ bù wán
en: That is so many clothes; I can't wash them all on my own.
why: 这么多 and 一个人 point to 'cannot', so 不 replaces 得 in 洗不完. 洗得完 would mean it is manageable.

q: 小字我看___见，不用戴眼镜。
zh: 小字我看得见，不用戴眼镜。
py: xiǎo zì wǒ kàn de jiàn bù yòng dài yǎn jìng
en: I can see small print; I don't need glasses.
why: 不用戴眼镜 shows that the person can see, so 看得见. 看不见 would mean cannot see and clash with the second clause.

q: 只要攒一年的钱，我们就买___起那套房子。
zh: 只要攒一年的钱，我们就买得起那套房子。
py: zhǐ yào zǎn yī nián de qián wǒ men jiù mǎi de qǐ nà tào fáng zi
en: If we save for a year, we will be able to afford that flat.
why: 只要……就 sets up a condition under which it becomes possible, so 买得起. 买不起 would contradict the 'as soon as we save' meaning.

q: 这个沙发太大，门这么小，我们肯定搬___进去。
zh: 这个沙发太大，门这么小，我们肯定搬不进去。
py: zhè ge shā fā tài dà mén zhè me xiǎo wǒ men kěn dìng bān bù jìn qù
en: This sofa is too big and the door is so small; we definitely can't get it in.
why: 太大 and 这么小 give the reason for 'cannot', so 不 takes the place of 得 in 搬不进去. 得 would claim that it fits.

q: 弟弟小声___告诉我，妈妈给他买了新书包。
zh: 弟弟小声地告诉我，妈妈给他买了新书包。
py: dì di xiǎo shēng de gào su wǒ mā ma gěi tā mǎi le xīn shū bāo
en: My younger brother whispered to me that Mum had bought him a new school bag.
why: 小声 is the manner in which he told me and sits before the verb 告诉, so 地. 得 needs a verb right before it, and none stands before 小声 here.

q: 弟弟认真___整理自己的房间。
zh: 弟弟认真地整理自己的房间。
py: dì di rèn zhēn de zhěng lǐ zì jǐ de fáng jiān
en: My younger brother is carefully tidying his own room.
why: 认真 describes how he tidies and comes before the verb 整理, so 地. 得 requires a verb before the gap.

q: 售货员热情___向我们介绍了这件衣服。
zh: 售货员热情地向我们介绍了这件衣服。
py: shòu huò yuán rè qíng de xiàng wǒ men jiè shào le zhè jiàn yī fu
en: The shop assistant warmly introduced this piece of clothing to us.
why: 热情 is the manner of 介绍, a verb phrase that follows the gap, so 地. 得 would need 热情 to judge a verb that precedes it.

q: 爸爸小心___把花瓶放在桌子上。
zh: 爸爸小心地把花瓶放在桌子上。
py: bà ba xiǎo xīn de bǎ huā píng fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
en: Dad carefully put the vase on the table.
why: 小心 is how Dad did the placing and sits before the 把 phrase and verb, so 地. 得 would need a verb right before it.

q: 爷爷安静___坐在沙发上看报纸。
zh: 爷爷安静地坐在沙发上看报纸。
py: yé ye ān jìng de zuò zài shā fā shàng kàn bào zhǐ
en: Grandpa sat quietly on the sofa reading the newspaper.
why: 安静 describes the manner of 坐 and comes before it, so 地. Only a verb before the gap could make 得 possible.

q: 妈妈耐心___听完了孩子的解释，然后笑了。
zh: 妈妈耐心地听完了孩子的解释，然后笑了。
py: mā ma nài xīn de tīng wán le hái zi de jiě shì rán hòu xiào le
en: Mum listened patiently to her child's explanation to the end, and then smiled.
why: 耐心 is the manner of listening and comes before the verb 听完, so 地. 得 would have to follow a verb such as 听.

q: 老板抱歉___告诉顾客，这个已经卖完了。
zh: 老板抱歉地告诉顾客，这个已经卖完了。
py: lǎo bǎn bào qiàn de gào su gù kè zhè ge yǐ jīng mài wán le
en: The boss apologetically told the customer that this was already sold out.
why: 抱歉 is the manner in which he told the customer, and a verb follows, so 地. 得 needs a verb before it.

q: 你慢慢___说，我听不懂。
zh: 你慢慢地说，我听不懂。
py: nǐ màn màn de shuō wǒ tīng bù dǒng
en: Speak slowly; I can't follow.
why: 慢慢 is doubled but what decides is position: it comes before the verb 说, so 地. After a verb it would be 得.

q: 妈妈轻轻___把宝宝放在床上。
zh: 妈妈轻轻地把宝宝放在床上。
py: mā ma qīng qīng de bǎ bǎo bao fàng zài chuáng shàng
en: Mum gently put the baby on the bed.
why: 轻轻 describes the manner of the placing and comes before the verb phrase, so 地. 得 would require a verb before the gap.

q: 她有一双大大___眼睛。
zh: 她有一双大大的眼睛。
py: tā yǒu yī shuāng dà dà de yǎn jing
en: She has a pair of big eyes.
why: 大大 is doubled, but the next word is the noun 眼睛, so 的. Doubling does not call for 地; the word after the gap does.

q: 桌子上放着一个圆圆___蛋糕。
zh: 桌子上放着一个圆圆的蛋糕。
py: zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yī gè yuán yuán de dàn gāo
en: There is a round cake on the table.
why: 圆圆 describes the noun 蛋糕, so 的. 地 is only for words that go before a verb.

q: 妈妈把房间打扫___干干净净。
zh: 妈妈把房间打扫得干干净净。
py: mā ma bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo de gān gān jìng jìng
en: Mum cleaned the room spotless.
why: 干干净净 is the result of 打扫, so it follows the verb with 得. Doubling does not make it 地, because 打扫 comes right before the gap.

q: 她把头发梳___整整齐齐，才出门。
zh: 她把头发梳得整整齐齐，才出门。
py: tā bǎ tóu fa shū de zhěng zhěng qí qí cái chū mén
en: She combed her hair neatly before going out.
why: 整整齐齐 describes the result of 梳, placed after the verb, so 得. 地 would put the word before the verb, as in 整整齐齐地梳。

q: 他是个很认真___学生，每天都做作业。
zh: 他是个很认真的学生，每天都做作业。
py: tā shì gè hěn rèn zhēn de xué sheng měi tiān dōu zuò zuò yè
en: He is a very conscientious student and does his homework every day.
why: 认真 is often seen with 地, but here the next word is the noun 学生, so it must be 的.

q: 弟弟每天都认真___做作业。
zh: 弟弟每天都认真地做作业。
py: dì di měi tiān dōu rèn zhēn de zuò zuò yè
en: My younger brother does his homework carefully every day.
why: 认真 comes before the verb 做, describing the manner of doing it, so 地. After a verb it would be 得, and before a noun 的.

q: 弟弟做作业做___很认真。
zh: 弟弟做作业做得很认真。
py: dì di zuò zuò yè zuò de hěn rèn zhēn
en: My younger brother does his homework very conscientiously.
why: The verb 做 is repeated after its object, and 很认真 is a judgement of how he does it, so 得. The same 认真 takes 地 before a verb.

q: 请给我一个清楚___回答。
zh: 请给我一个清楚的回答。
py: qǐng gěi wǒ yī gè qīng chu de huí dá
en: Please give me a clear answer.
why: 清楚 describes the noun 回答, so 的. The same adjective would take 地 before a verb (清楚地说) and 得 after one (说得清楚).

q: 请你把问题清楚___告诉我。
zh: 请你把问题清楚地告诉我。
py: qǐng nǐ bǎ wèn tí qīng chu de gào su wǒ
en: Please tell me the problem clearly.
why: 清楚 sits before the verb 告诉 and says how to tell, so 地. 的 needs a noun after it, and 得 needs a verb before it.

q: 坐在前排，我们看___很清楚。
zh: 坐在前排，我们看得很清楚。
py: zuò zài qián pái wǒ men kàn de hěn qīng chu
en: Sitting in the front row, we could see very clearly.
why: 很清楚 judges how well they see, and it comes after the verb 看, so 得. The same word before a noun takes 的 and before a verb 地.

q: 她努力___工作，想给家里买一套房子。
zh: 她努力地工作，想给家里买一套房子。
py: tā nǔ lì de gōng zuò xiǎng gěi jiā lǐ mǎi yī tào fáng zi
en: She works hard because she wants to buy a flat for her family.
why: 努力 is the manner of working and comes before the verb 工作, so 地. 得 would require 努力 to follow a verb.

s: 妈妈做的菜比饭店的还好吃。
s_py: mā ma zuò de cài bǐ fàn diàn de hái hǎo chī
zh: 妈妈做的菜比饭店的还好吃。
py: mā ma zuò de cài bǐ fàn diàn de hái hǎo chī
en: The food Mum makes is even tastier than the restaurant's.
why: Correct: 妈妈做 describes the noun 菜, so 的. A verb before 的 does not make it 得.

s: 我买的比她买的便宜。
s_py: wǒ mǎi de bǐ tā mǎi de pián yi
zh: 我买的比她买的便宜。
py: wǒ mǎi de bǐ tā mǎi de pián yi
en: What I bought is cheaper than what she bought.
why: Correct: both 买的 stand for 'the thing bought' with the noun left out, so 的 is right.

s: 这是姐姐昨天买得衣服。
s_py: zhè shì jiě jie zuó tiān mǎi de yī fu
zh: 这是姐姐昨天买的衣服。
py: zhè shì jiě jie zuó tiān mǎi de yī fu
en: This is the clothing my older sister bought yesterday.
why: The gap is followed by the noun 衣服, so the clause 姐姐昨天买 is joined with 的. 得 needs a judgement word after it.

s: 我不喜欢太甜的东西。
s_py: wǒ bù xǐ huan tài tián de dōng xi
zh: 我不喜欢太甜的东西。
py: wǒ bù xǐ huan tài tián de dōng xi
en: I don't like things that are too sweet.
why: Correct: 太甜 describes the noun 东西, so 的 is right even though the phrase starts with 太.

s: 这是一件很便宜得衣服。
s_py: zhè shì yī jiàn hěn pián yi de yī fu
zh: 这是一件很便宜的衣服。
py: zhè shì yī jiàn hěn pián yi de yī fu
en: This is a very cheap piece of clothing.
why: 得 follows a verb and leads to a judgement; here the adjective 便宜 describes the noun 衣服, so it must be 的.

s: 她送给我一条很漂亮地裙子。
s_py: tā sòng gěi wǒ yī tiáo hěn piào liang de qún zi
zh: 她送给我一条很漂亮的裙子。
py: tā sòng gěi wǒ yī tiáo hěn piào liang de qún zi
en: She gave me a very pretty skirt.
why: 地 goes before a verb. The word after the gap is the noun 裙子, so 很漂亮 needs 的.

s: 弟弟哭得眼睛都红了。
s_py: dì di kū de yǎn jing dōu hóng le
zh: 弟弟哭得眼睛都红了。
py: dì di kū de yǎn jing dōu hóng le
en: My younger brother cried until his eyes were red.
why: Correct: 得 follows the verb 哭 and introduces the result 眼睛都红了. No 了 is needed after 哭.

s: 奶奶今天不起得早。
s_py: nǎi nai jīn tiān bù qǐ de zǎo
zh: 奶奶今天起得不早。
py: nǎi nai jīn tiān qǐ de bù zǎo
en: Grandma didn't get up early today.
why: The negative belongs to the judgement after 得: 起得不早. 不 cannot stand before the verb in this pattern.

s: 哥哥跑地很快。
s_py: gē ge pǎo de hěn kuài
zh: 哥哥跑得很快。
py: gē ge pǎo de hěn kuài
en: My older brother runs fast.
why: 很快 judges how he runs, and it follows the verb 跑, so 得. 地 only goes before a verb.

s: 妹妹跳得舞很好。
s_py: mèi mei tiào de wǔ hěn hǎo
zh: 妹妹跳舞跳得很好。
py: mèi mei tiào wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo
en: My younger sister dances well.
why: 得 must come right after the verb being judged and cannot be followed by the object 舞. Repeat the verb: 跳舞跳得很好.

s: 妈妈忙地没时间吃饭。
s_py: mā ma máng de méi shí jiān chī fàn
zh: 妈妈忙得没时间吃饭。
py: mā ma máng de méi shí jiān chī fàn
en: Mum is so busy that she has no time to eat.
why: 没时间吃饭 is the result of being busy, so 忙得. 地 would make 忙 the manner of eating.

s: 她高兴得一晚上没睡着。
s_py: tā gāo xìng de yī wǎn shang méi shuì zháo
zh: 她高兴得一晚上没睡着。
py: tā gāo xìng de yī wǎn shang méi shuì zháo
en: She was so happy that she didn't sleep all night.
why: Correct: 没睡着 is a result, so 高兴得 is right. 高兴地 would describe how she did something.

s: 弟弟困地眼睛都睁不开了。
s_py: dì di kùn de yǎn jing dōu zhēng bù kāi le
zh: 弟弟困得眼睛都睁不开了。
py: dì di kùn de yǎn jing dōu zhēng bù kāi le
en: My younger brother was so sleepy that he couldn't keep his eyes open.
why: 眼睛都睁不开了 is the result of being sleepy, so 困得. 困 is a state and cannot be a manner before a verb, so 地 fails.

s: 姐姐写字写得很漂亮。
s_py: jiě jie xiě zì xiě de hěn piào liang
zh: 姐姐写字写得很漂亮。
py: jiě jie xiě zì xiě de hěn piào liang
en: My older sister writes beautifully.
why: Correct: the object 字 is followed by the repeated verb 写, and 得 attaches to that second verb.

s: 妹妹唱歌得很好听。
s_py: mèi mei chàng gē de hěn hǎo tīng
zh: 妹妹唱歌唱得很好听。
py: mèi mei chàng gē chàng de hěn hǎo tīng
en: My younger sister sings beautifully.
why: 得 cannot follow the object 歌. The verb 唱 must be repeated first: 唱歌唱得.

s: 爸爸开车得很慢。
s_py: bà ba kāi chē de hěn màn
zh: 爸爸开车开得很慢。
py: bà ba kāi chē kāi de hěn màn
en: Dad drives slowly.
why: 得 must attach to the verb, not the object 车, so repeat 开: 开车开得很慢.

s: 弟弟写作业得很认真。
s_py: dì di xiě zuò yè de hěn rèn zhēn
zh: 弟弟写作业写得很认真。
py: dì di xiě zuò yè xiě de hěn rèn zhēn
en: My younger brother does his homework very conscientiously.
why: 作业 is the object, so 得 cannot come right after it. Repeat 写 before 得.

s: 他汉语说得很流利，不像刚学了一年。
s_py: tā hàn yǔ shuō de hěn liú lì bù xiàng gāng xué le yī nián
zh: 他汉语说得很流利，不像刚学了一年。
py: tā hàn yǔ shuō de hěn liú lì bù xiàng gāng xué le yī nián
en: He speaks Chinese very fluently; you wouldn't think he has only just studied for a year.
why: Correct: the object 汉语 is moved to the front as a topic, so 说 does not need repeating and 得 follows the verb.

s: 这个箱子太重了，我一个人搬不动。
s_py: zhè ge xiāng zi tài zhòng le wǒ yī gè rén bān bù dòng
zh: 这个箱子太重了，我一个人搬不动。
py: zhè ge xiāng zi tài zhòng le wǒ yī gè rén bān bù dòng
en: This box is too heavy; I can't move it on my own.
why: Correct: 'cannot' swaps 得 for 不 in 搬不动. No other 不 is needed anywhere.

s: 钱不够，我们买不起那个冰箱。
s_py: qián bù gòu wǒ men mǎi bù qǐ nà ge bīng xiāng
zh: 钱不够，我们买不起那个冰箱。
py: qián bù gòu wǒ men mǎi bù qǐ nà ge bīng xiāng
en: We don't have enough money; we can't afford that fridge.
why: Correct: 买不起 is the negative of 买得起, with 不 in place of 得.

s: 我不看得懂这个说明书。
s_py: wǒ bù kàn de dǒng zhè ge shuō míng shū
zh: 我看不懂这个说明书。
py: wǒ kàn bù dǒng zhè ge shuō míng shū
en: I can't understand these instructions.
why: 'Cannot' is formed by replacing 得 with 不: 看不懂. Putting 不 before the verb is not allowed.

s: 这么多菜，我吃得不完。
s_py: zhè me duō cài wǒ chī de bù wán
zh: 这么多菜，我吃不完。
py: zhè me duō cài wǒ chī bù wán
en: That's so much food; I can't finish it.
why: The 'cannot' form is 吃不完, with 不 instead of 得. 得不 does not occur in this frame.

s: 售货员慢慢地走过来，笑着问我们要什么。
s_py: shòu huò yuán màn màn de zǒu guò lái xiào zhe wèn wǒ men yào shén me
zh: 售货员慢慢地走过来，笑着问我们要什么。
py: shòu huò yuán màn màn de zǒu guò lái xiào zhe wèn wǒ men yào shén me
en: The shop assistant walked over slowly and asked us with a smile what we wanted.
why: Correct: 慢慢 comes before the verb 走过来 as its manner, so 地.

s: 老师认真得听学生的回答。
s_py: lǎo shī rèn zhēn de tīng xué sheng de huí dá
zh: 老师认真地听学生的回答。
py: lǎo shī rèn zhēn de tīng xué sheng de huí dá
en: The teacher listens carefully to the students' answers.
why: 认真 sits before the verb 听 and describes how it is done, so 地. 得 would need a verb in front of it.

s: 孩子们高高兴兴地去超市买玩具。
s_py: hái zi men gāo gāo xìng xìng de qù chāo shì mǎi wán jù
zh: 孩子们高高兴兴地去超市买玩具。
py: hái zi men gāo gāo xìng xìng de qù chāo shì mǎi wán jù
en: The children went happily to the supermarket to buy toys.
why: Correct: the doubled adjective comes before the verb 去, so 地.

s: 她把客厅打扫得干干净净。
s_py: tā bǎ kè tīng dǎ sǎo de gān gān jìng jìng
zh: 她把客厅打扫得干干净净。
py: tā bǎ kè tīng dǎ sǎo de gān gān jìng jìng
en: She cleaned the living room spotless.
why: Correct: 干干净净 is the result of 打扫, so it takes 得 even though it is doubled.

zh: 我喜欢妈妈做的那道菜。
py: wǒ xǐ huan mā ma zuò de nà dào cài
en: I like the dish Mum made.
why: 妈妈做 is a clause that describes 那道菜, so 的 follows 做 and the noun comes last. 得 is a distractor because it needs a judgement word after it. The whole 妈妈做的那道菜 can also be fronted as the topic.

zh: 弟弟今天起得很早。
py: dì di jīn tiān qǐ de hěn zǎo
en: My younger brother got up very early today.
why: 得 goes straight after the verb 起 and the judgement 很早 follows it. The time word may come before or after the subject.

zh: 爷爷慢慢地走进房间。
py: yé ye màn màn de zǒu jìn fáng jiān
en: Grandpa walked slowly into the room.
why: 慢慢 describes the manner and goes before the verb 走进, joined by 地. The adverbial cannot come after the verb.

zh: 弟弟洗衣服洗得很干净。
py: dì di xǐ yī fu xǐ de hěn gān jìng
en: My younger brother gets clothes very clean when he washes them.
why: 得 cannot follow the object 衣服, so the verb 洗 is repeated and 得 attaches to the second 洗, followed by the judgement.

zh: 我听不懂他说的话。
py: wǒ tīng bù dǒng tā shuō de huà
en: I can't understand what he says.
why: 'Cannot' is 听不懂, with 不 in the place of 得 right after the verb. The object may also be fronted as the topic.
